title: Skills follow-up of #36455: objectstack-data still points at the removed subforms section and does not teach showOnCreate; automation and the skills README still route single-object step forms to wizard
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRY38EZf38Yy3zthbY

Filed by the seat from the #36455 dev (PR #36609, `skills/objectstack-ui`), outside that card's scope. Not claimed. Related: #36455, #36158 (in flight on the same objectstack-data file).

Suggested-grade: p2
Suggested-domain: `domain:skills`

## Where

1. `skills/objectstack-data/.../relationships.md` around line 278 still links to the subforms override section that was removed.
2. The objectstack-data skill does not teach `showOnCreate` (the UI skill now does, after #36455).
3. `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` around line 44 and `skills/README.md` around line 125 route "a single-object step form" to wizard. Today that holds only for a named form that an action opens.

## Ask

Correct the three places so a metadata author is taught the current behaviour, with the evals that exercise it. Run the overlap check against #36158 before claiming (same objectstack-data file); land after it if both are open.

## Re-check

`git grep -n "subforms" skills/objectstack-data` and `git grep -n -i "wizard" skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md skills/README.md` show the stale lines until fixed.
